sentences.japanese: 彼[かれ]はイギリス人[いぎりすじん]です。
sentences.english: He is British.
sentences.question: 彼はどこの国の人ですか？
sentences.question_english: What country is he from?

sentences.japanese: 私[わたし]の先生[せんせい]はイギリス人[いぎりすじん]で、英語[えいご]を教[おし]えています。
sentences.english: My teacher is British and teaches English.
sentences.question: 先生は何を教えていますか？
sentences.question_english: What does the teacher teach?

sentences.japanese: 箱[はこ]の内[うち]に何[なに]が入[はい]っていますか。
sentences.english: What is inside the box?
sentences.question: 何の内を聞いていますか？
sentences.question_english: What are they asking about the inside of?

sentences.japanese: 三日[みっか]の内[うち]に返事[へんじ]をください。
sentences.english: Please reply within three days.
sentences.question: いつまでに返事をしなければなりませんか？
sentences.question_english: By when must they reply?

sentences.japanese: 車[くるま]が三台[さんだい]あります。
sentences.english: There are three cars.
sentences.question: 車は何台ありますか？
sentences.question_english: How many cars are there?

sentences.japanese: パソコンを一台[いちだい]買[か]いました。
sentences.english: I bought one computer.
sentences.question: 何を買いましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did they buy?

sentences.japanese: このクラスには学生[がくせい]が二十人[にじゅうにん]います。
sentences.english: There are twenty students in this class.
sentences.question: このクラスに学生は何人いますか？
sentences.question_english: How many students are in this class?

sentences.japanese: パーティーに五人[ごにん]来[き]ました。
sentences.english: Five people came to the party.
sentences.question: パーティーに何人来ましたか？
sentences.question_english: How many people came to the party?

sentences.japanese: あの少女[しょうじょ]は白[しろ]い服[ふく]を着[き]ています。
sentences.english: That young girl is wearing white clothes.
sentences.question: 少女はどんな服を着ていますか？
sentences.question_english: What kind of clothes is the girl wearing?

sentences.japanese: 少女[しょうじょ]が公園[こうえん]で遊[あそ]んでいます。
sentences.english: A young girl is playing in the park.
sentences.question: 少女はどこで遊んでいますか？
sentences.question_english: Where is the girl playing?

sentences.japanese: このかばんは一万[いちまん]円[えん]です。
sentences.english: This bag costs ten thousand yen.
sentences.question: このかばんはいくらですか？
sentences.question_english: How much does this bag cost?

sentences.japanese: この町[まち]には三万[さんまん]人[にん]が住[す]んでいます。
sentences.english: Thirty thousand people live in this town.
sentences.question: この町に何人住んでいますか？
sentences.question_english: How many people live in this town?

sentences.japanese: 今日は[こんにちは]、お元気[げんき]ですか。
sentences.english: Hello, how are you?
sentences.question: この言葉はいつ使いますか？
sentences.question_english: When do you use this expression?

sentences.japanese: 先生[せんせい]に会[あ]ったとき、今日は[こんにちは]と言[い]いました。
sentences.english: When I met my teacher, I said hello.
sentences.question: 先生に会ったとき、何と言いましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did they say when they met the teacher?

sentences.japanese: 今日[きょう]は用[よう]があるので、早[はや]く帰[かえ]ります。
sentences.english: I have something to do today, so I will go home early.
sentences.question: なぜ早く帰りますか？
sentences.question_english: Why are they going home early?

sentences.japanese: 何[なに]か用[よう]がありますか。
sentences.english: Do you have something you need?
sentences.question: この人は何を聞いていますか？
sentences.question_english: What is this person asking?

sentences.japanese: あの子[こ]は大人しい[おとなしい]ので、授業[じゅぎょう]中[ちゅう]に静[しず]かです。
sentences.english: That child is quiet, so they are calm during class.
sentences.question: あの子はどんな性格ですか？
sentences.question_english: What kind of personality does that child have?

sentences.japanese: うちの犬[いぬ]はとても大人しい[おとなしい]です。
sentences.english: My dog is very calm.
sentences.question: 犬はどんな性格ですか？
sentences.question_english: What kind of personality does the dog have?

sentences.japanese: 戸[と]を閉[し]めてください。
sentences.english: Please close the door.
sentences.question: 何をしてほしいですか？
sentences.question_english: What do they want you to do?

sentences.japanese: 戸[と]が開[あ]いていますよ。
sentences.english: The door is open.
sentences.question: 戸はどんな状態ですか？
sentences.question_english: What state is the door in?

sentences.japanese: あの女の人[おんなのひと]はだれですか。
sentences.english: Who is that woman?
sentences.question: 何について聞いていますか？
sentences.question_english: What are they asking about?

sentences.japanese: 女の人[おんなのひと]がレジの前[まえ]に立[た]っています。
sentences.english: A woman is standing in front of the cash register.
sentences.question: 女の人はどこに立っていますか？
sentences.question_english: Where is the woman standing?

sentences.japanese: 地図[ちず]を広[ひろ]げて、道[みち]を調[しら]べました。
sentences.english: I spread out the map and checked the route.
sentences.question: 何を広げましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did they spread out?

sentences.japanese: 傘[かさ]を広[ひろ]げてください。雨[あめ]が降[ふ]っています。
sentences.english: Please open your umbrella. It is raining.
sentences.question: なぜ傘を広げますか？
sentences.question_english: Why are they opening the umbrella?

sentences.japanese: 山[やま]で大[おお]きな声[こえ]を出[だ]したら、山びこ[やまびこ]が聞[き]こえました。
sentences.english: When I shouted loudly in the mountains, I heard an echo.
sentences.question: 山で何が聞こえましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did they hear in the mountains?

sentences.japanese: 田中[たなか]先生[せんせい]は数学[すうがく]を教[おし]えています。
sentences.english: Teacher Tanaka teaches math.
sentences.question: 田中先生は何[なに]を教えていますか？
sentences.question_english: What does Teacher Tanaka teach?

sentences.japanese: 先生[せんせい]、質問[しつもん]があります。
sentences.english: Teacher, I have a question.
sentences.question: この人[ひと]は何[なに]がありますか？
sentences.question_english: What does this person have?

sentences.japanese: 彼[かれ]は料理[りょうり]の名人[めいじん]です。
sentences.english: He is a master of cooking.
sentences.question: 彼は何[なに]の名人ですか？
sentences.question_english: What is he a master of?

sentences.japanese: あなたの名字[みょうじ]は何[なん]ですか？
sentences.english: What is your last name?
sentences.question: 何[なに]を聞[き]いていますか？
sentences.question_english: What is being asked?

sentences.japanese: 私[わたし]の名字[みょうじ]は山田[やまだ]です。
sentences.english: My last name is Yamada.
sentences.question: この人[ひと]の名字は何ですか？
sentences.question_english: What is this person's last name?

sentences.japanese: この文字[もじ]は読[よ]めません。
sentences.english: I cannot read this character.
sentences.question: この人[ひと]はこの文字が読めますか？
sentences.question_english: Can this person read this character?

sentences.japanese: 日本語[にほんご]には三[みっ]つの文字[もじ]があります。
sentences.english: Japanese has three writing systems.
sentences.question: 日本語にはいくつの文字がありますか？
sentences.question_english: How many writing systems does Japanese have?

sentences.japanese: 彼[かれ]の口[くち]は一文字[いちもんじ]になっています。
sentences.english: His mouth is set in a straight line.
sentences.question: 彼の口はどうなっていますか？
sentences.question_english: What does his mouth look like?

sentences.japanese: ２０１１年[にせんじゅういちねん]に大[おお]きい地震[じしん]がありました。
sentences.english: There was a big earthquake in 2011.
sentences.question: いつ大きい地震がありましたか？
sentences.question_english: When was there a big earthquake?

sentences.japanese: この仕事[しごと]は年内[ねんない]に終[お]わります。
sentences.english: This work will be finished by the end of the year.
sentences.question: 仕事はいつ終わりますか？
sentences.question_english: When will the work be finished?

sentences.japanese: この店[みせ]は年中[ねんじゅう]開[あ]いています。
sentences.english: This store is open all year round.
sentences.question: この店はいつ開いていますか？
sentences.question_english: When is this store open?

sentences.japanese: 彼女[かのじょ]は年中[ねんじゅう]忙[いそが]しいです。
sentences.english: She is busy all year long.
sentences.question: 彼女[かのじょ]はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: How is she?

sentences.japanese: 私[わたし]は今年[ことし]、一年生[いちねんせい]になりました。
sentences.english: This year, I became a first-year student.
sentences.question: この人[ひと]は今年何年生[なんねんせい]になりましたか？
sentences.question_english: What year did this person become this year?

sentences.japanese: あの少年[しょうねん]はとても元気[げんき]です。
sentences.english: That boy is very energetic.
sentences.question: あの少年はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: How is that boy?

sentences.japanese: 少年[しょうねん]が公園[こうえん]でサッカーをしています。
sentences.english: A boy is playing soccer in the park.
sentences.question: 少年はどこでサッカーをしていますか？
sentences.question_english: Where is the boy playing soccer?

sentences.japanese: 去年[きょねん]、日本[にほん]に行[い]きました。
sentences.english: Last year, I went to Japan.
sentences.question: いつ日本に行きましたか？
sentences.question_english: When did you go to Japan?

sentences.japanese: 去年[きょねん]の冬[ふゆ]はとても寒[さむ]かったです。
sentences.english: Last year's winter was very cold.
sentences.question: 去年の冬はどうでしたか？
sentences.question_english: What was last year's winter like?

sentences.japanese: 今朝[けさ]は早[はや]く起[お]きました。
sentences.english: I woke up early this morning.
sentences.question: 今朝、何時[なんじ]ごろ起きましたか？
sentences.question_english: Around what time did you wake up this morning?

sentences.japanese: この電車[でんしゃ]は早[はや]いです。
sentences.english: This train is fast.
sentences.question: この電車はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What is this train like?

sentences.japanese: 家[いえ]に帰[かえ]るとすぐに、早々[はやばや]と寝[ね]ました。
sentences.english: As soon as I got home, I quickly went to sleep.
sentences.question: 家に帰ってから何をしましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did you do after getting home?

sentences.japanese: 今日[きょう]は気[き]をつけてください。
sentences.english: Please take care today.
sentences.question: 何[なに]をしてくださいと言[い]っていますか？
sentences.question_english: What are they being asked to do?

sentences.japanese: 元気[げんき]がなくて、心配[しんぱい]です。
sentences.english: I am worried because he has no energy.
sentences.question: なぜ心配していますか？
sentences.question_english: Why are they worried?

sentences.japanese: この服[ふく]がとても気[き]に入[い]りました。
sentences.english: I really took a liking to these clothes.
sentences.question: この人[ひと]はこの服が好[す]きですか？
sentences.question_english: Does this person like these clothes?

sentences.japanese: 新[あたら]しいかばんが気[き]に入[い]りましたか？
sentences.english: Did you take a liking to the new bag?
sentences.question: 何[なに]について聞[き]いていますか？
sentences.question_english: What are they asking about?

sentences.japanese: コップの水[みず]を一気[いっき]に飲[の]みました。
sentences.english: I drank the glass of water in one go.
sentences.question: 水をどのように飲みましたか？
sentences.question_english: How did you drink the water?

sentences.japanese: 宿題[しゅくだい]を一気[いっき]に終[お]わらせました。
sentences.english: I finished my homework all at once.
sentences.question: 宿題をどのように終わらせましたか？
sentences.question_english: How did you finish your homework?

sentences.japanese: 今日[きょう]は気分[きぶん]がいいです。
sentences.english: I am in a good mood today.
sentences.question: 今日の気分はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: How is your mood today?

sentences.japanese: 少[すこ]し気分[きぶん]が悪[わる]いので、休[やす]みます。
sentences.english: I feel a little unwell, so I will rest.
sentences.question: どうして休みますか？
sentences.question_english: Why are you going to rest?

sentences.japanese: このカフェはとても人気[にんき]があります。
sentences.english: This cafe is very popular.
sentences.question: このカフェはどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What is this cafe like?

sentences.japanese: あの歌手[かしゅ]は学生[がくせい]に人気[にんき]があります。
sentences.english: That singer is popular among students.
sentences.question: あの歌手は誰に人気がありますか？
sentences.question_english: Who is that singer popular with?

sentences.japanese: 毎朝[まいあさ]、元気[げんき]に学校[がっこう]へ行[い]きます。
sentences.english: Every morning I go to school energetically.
sentences.question: 毎朝どこへ行きますか？
sentences.question_english: Where do you go every morning?

sentences.japanese: お元気[げんき]ですか？
sentences.english: How are you? / Are you well?
sentences.question: これはどんな意味[いみ]の言葉[ことば]ですか？
sentences.question_english: What does this expression mean?

sentences.japanese: 今日[きょう]の天気[てんき]はいいですね。
sentences.english: The weather today is nice, isn't it.
sentences.question: 今日の天気はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What is the weather like today?

sentences.japanese: 明日[あした]の天気[てんき]はどうですか？
sentences.english: What will the weather be like tomorrow?
sentences.question: 何について聞いていますか？
sentences.question_english: What are they asking about?

sentences.japanese: 彼[かれ]は本気[ほんき]で日本語[にほんご]を勉強[べんきょう]しています。
sentences.english: He is seriously studying Japanese.
sentences.question: 彼はどのように日本語を勉強していますか？
sentences.question_english: How is he studying Japanese?

sentences.japanese: 本気[ほんき]ですか？冗談[じょうだん]ですか？
sentences.english: Are you serious? Or are you joking?
sentences.question: この人は何を聞いていますか？
sentences.question_english: What is this person asking?

sentences.japanese: 大丈夫[だいじょうぶ]ですか？　はい、平気[へいき]です。
sentences.english: Are you okay? Yes, I am fine.
sentences.question: この人は今どうですか？
sentences.question_english: How is this person right now?

sentences.japanese: 寒[さむ]くても彼女[かのじょ]は平気[へいき]です。
sentences.english: Even when it is cold, she is fine.
sentences.question: 彼女は寒いときどうですか？
sentences.question_english: How is she when it is cold?

sentences.japanese: 兄[あに]は一本気[いっぽんぎ]な人[ひと]です。
sentences.english: My older brother is a single-minded person.
sentences.question: 兄はどんな人ですか？
sentences.question_english: What kind of person is the older brother?

sentences.japanese: この車[くるま]は百万[ひゃくまん]円[えん]です。
sentences.english: This car costs one million yen.
sentences.question: この車はいくらですか？
sentences.question_english: How much does this car cost?

sentences.japanese: その会社[かいしゃ]の社員[しゃいん]は百万[ひゃくまん]人[にん]います。
sentences.english: That company has one million employees.
sentences.question: その会社に社員は何人いますか？
sentences.question_english: How many employees does that company have?

sentences.japanese: このりんごは四百[よんひゃく]円[えん]です。
sentences.english: These apples are four hundred yen.
sentences.question: このりんごはいくらですか？
sentences.question_english: How much are these apples?

sentences.japanese: この本[ほん]は五百[ごひゃく]円[えん]で買[か]えます。
sentences.english: You can buy this book for five hundred yen.
sentences.question: この本はいくらで買えますか？
sentences.question_english: How much can you buy this book for?

sentences.japanese: バスで二百[にひゃく]メートル行[い]くと、駅[えき]があります。
sentences.english: If you go two hundred meters by bus, there is a station.
sentences.question: 駅はどこにありますか？
sentences.question_english: Where is the station?

sentences.japanese: 春[はる]になると、竹[たけ]の子[こ]が食[た]べられます。
sentences.english: When spring comes, bamboo shoots can be eaten.
sentences.question: 竹の子はいつ食べられますか？
sentences.question_english: When can bamboo shoots be eaten?

sentences.japanese: 母[はは]は竹[たけ]の子[こ]と野菜[やさい]を炒[いた]めました。
sentences.english: My mother stir-fried bamboo shoots and vegetables.
sentences.question: 母は何を炒めましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did the mother stir-fry?

sentences.japanese: 公園[こうえん]に竹[たけ]がたくさん生[は]えています。
sentences.english: There is a lot of bamboo growing in the park.
sentences.question: 公園に何がありますか？
sentences.question_english: What is in the park?

sentences.japanese: 竹[たけ]はとても強[つよ]い植物[しょくぶつ]です。
sentences.english: Bamboo is a very strong plant.
sentences.question: 竹はどんな植物ですか？
sentences.question_english: What kind of plant is bamboo?

sentences.japanese: 母[はは]は赤[あか]い糸[いと]でセーターを作[つく]りました。
sentences.english: My mother made a sweater with red thread.
sentences.question: 母は何で何を作りましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did the mother make and with what?

sentences.japanese: この糸[いと]はとても細[ほそ]いです。
sentences.english: This thread is very thin.
sentences.question: この糸はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What is this thread like?

sentences.japanese: 耳[みみ]が痛[いた]いです。
sentences.english: My ears hurt.
sentences.question: どこが痛いですか？
sentences.question_english: Where does it hurt?

sentences.japanese: 犬[いぬ]の耳[みみ]は大[おお]きいです。
sentences.english: The dog's ears are big.
sentences.question: 犬の耳はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What are the dog's ears like?

sentences.japanese: 庭[にわ]に虫[むし]がいます。
sentences.english: There is a bug in the garden.
sentences.question: 虫はどこにいますか？
sentences.question_english: Where is the bug?

sentences.japanese: この虫[むし]は何[なん]ですか？
sentences.english: What is this insect?
sentences.question: 何について聞いていますか？
sentences.question_english: What are they asking about?

sentences.japanese: 祖父[そふ]は小[ちい]さい村[むら]に住[す]んでいます。
sentences.english: My grandfather lives in a small village.
sentences.question: 祖父はどこに住んでいますか？
sentences.question_english: Where does the grandfather live?

sentences.japanese: その村[むら]はとても静[しず]かです。
sentences.english: That village is very quiet.
sentences.question: その村はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What is that village like?

sentences.japanese: 村人[むらびと]たちはみんな親切[しんせつ]です。
sentences.english: All the villagers are kind.
sentences.question: 村人たちはどんな人ですか？
sentences.question_english: What kind of people are the villagers?

sentences.japanese: あの男[おとこ]の人[ひと]はだれですか？
sentences.english: Who is that man?
sentences.question: 何について聞いていますか？
sentences.question_english: What are they asking about?

sentences.japanese: 一人[ひとり]の男[おとこ]が店[みせ]に入[はい]りました。
sentences.english: One man entered the store.
sentences.question: 男の人はどこに入りましたか？
sentences.question_english: Where did the man enter?

sentences.japanese: この町[まち]にはいいレストランがたくさんあります。
sentences.english: There are many good restaurants in this town.
sentences.question: この町には何がたくさんありますか？
sentences.question_english: What are there many of in this town?

sentences.japanese: 私[わたし]はこの町[まち]に三年間[さんねんかん]住[す]んでいます。
sentences.english: I have been living in this town for three years.
sentences.question: どのくらいこの町に住んでいますか？
sentences.question_english: How long have they been living in this town?

sentences.japanese: テーブルの上[うえ]に花[はな]があります。
sentences.english: There are flowers on the table.
sentences.question: 花はどこにありますか？
sentences.question_english: Where are the flowers?

sentences.japanese: 母[はは]は花[はな]が好[す]きです。
sentences.english: My mother likes flowers.
sentences.question: お母さんは何が好きですか？
sentences.question_english: What does the mother like?

sentences.japanese: 夏[なつ]に花火[はなび]を見[み]ました。
sentences.english: I watched fireworks in summer.
sentences.question: いつ花火を見ましたか？
sentences.question_english: When did they watch fireworks?

sentences.japanese: 花火[はなび]はとてもきれいでした。
sentences.english: The fireworks were very beautiful.
sentences.question: 花火はどうでしたか？
sentences.question_english: What were the fireworks like?

sentences.english: My stomach hurts a little.
sentences.question: お腹はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: How is their stomach?

sentences.japanese: ここではタバコを吸[す]わないでください。
sentences.english: Please do not smoke cigarettes here.
sentences.question: ここで何をしてはいけませんか？
sentences.question_english: What must you not do here?

sentences.japanese: このレストランはタバコが禁止[きんし]です。
sentences.english: Smoking is prohibited in this restaurant.
sentences.question: このレストランではタバコはどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What is the rule about smoking in this restaurant?

sentences.japanese: このお店[みせ]はサービスがとてもいいです。
sentences.english: The service at this shop is very good.
sentences.question: このお店のサービスはどうですか？
sentences.question_english: How is the service at this shop?

sentences.japanese: ケーキをひとつ買[か]ったら、もうひとつサービスでもらいました。
sentences.english: When I bought one cake, I received another one for free.
sentences.question: ケーキをひとつ買ったら、どうなりましたか？
sentences.question_english: What happened when they bought one cake?

sentences.japanese: 雨[あめ]が降[ふ]っています。しかし、出[で]かけます。
sentences.english: It is raining. However, I am going out.
sentences.question: どんな天気[てんき]ですか？
sentences.question_english: What is the weather like?

sentences.japanese: お金[かね]がありません。しかし、買[か]いたいです。
sentences.english: I don't have money. However, I want to buy it.

sentences.question_english: Do they have money?

sentences.japanese: 朝[あさ]ごはんにパンを食[た]べました。
sentences.english: I ate bread for breakfast.
sentences.question: 朝ごはんに何[なに]を食べましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did they eat for breakfast?

sentences.japanese: このパンはとてもおいしいです。
sentences.english: This bread is very delicious.
sentences.question: このパンはどうですか？
sentences.question_english: How is this bread?

sentences.japanese: 今日[きょう]はとても暑[あつ]いです。
sentences.english: Today is very hot.
sentences.question: 今日の天気[てんき]はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: How is the weather today?

sentences.japanese: この映画[えいが]はとても面白[おもしろ]かったです。
sentences.english: This movie was very interesting.
sentences.question: この映画はどうでしたか？
sentences.question_english: How was this movie?

sentences.japanese: あの大[おお]きいビルはどこですか？
sentences.english: Where is that big building?
sentences.question: 何[なに]について聞[き]いていますか？
sentences.question_english: What are they asking about?

sentences.japanese: 銀行[ぎんこう]はあのビルの中[なか]にあります。
sentences.english: The bank is inside that building.
sentences.question: 銀行はどこにありますか？
sentences.question_english: Where is the bank?

sentences.japanese: 先生[せんせい]に日本語[にほんご]を教[おそ]わりました。
sentences.english: I was taught Japanese by my teacher.
sentences.question: だれに日本語を教わりましたか？
sentences.question_english: Who did they learn Japanese from?

sentences.japanese: 友達[ともだち]に料理[りょうり]を教わっています。
sentences.english: I am learning cooking from a friend.
sentences.question: 何[なに]を教わっていますか？
sentences.question_english: What are they learning?

sentences.japanese: 友達[ともだち]は六時[ろくじ]に去[さ]りました。
sentences.english: My friend left at six o'clock.
sentences.question: 友達は何時[なんじ]に去りましたか？
sentences.question_english: What time did the friend leave?

sentences.japanese: 電車[でんしゃ]はもう去[さ]りました。
sentences.english: The train has already left.
sentences.question: 電車はまだありますか？
sentences.question_english: Is the train still there?

sentences.japanese: 明後日[あさって]、友達[ともだち]と映画[えいが]を見[み]ます。
sentences.english: The day after tomorrow, I will watch a movie with a friend.
sentences.question: いつ映画を見ますか？
sentences.question_english: When will they watch a movie?

sentences.japanese: 明後日[あさって]は雨[あめ]が降[ふ]るそうです。
sentences.english: I heard it will rain the day after tomorrow.
sentences.question: 明後日の天気[てんき]はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What will the weather be like the day after tomorrow?

sentences.question_english: How many places did they go to?

sentences.japanese: 今日[きょう]は一ヶ所[いっかしょ]だけ買[か]い物[もの]します。
sentences.english: Today I will shop at only one place.

sentences.question_english: How many places will they shop at today?

sentences.japanese: 先生[せんせい]は黒板[こくばん]に直線[ちょくせん]を引[ひ]きました。

sentences.japanese: この道[みち]を直進[ちょくしん]してください。
sentences.english: Please go straight ahead on this road.
sentences.question: どうやって行[い]きますか？
sentences.question_english: How should they go?

sentences.japanese: 交差点[こうさてん]まで直進[ちょくしん]すると、右[みぎ]に駅[えき]があります。
sentences.english: If you go straight ahead to the intersection, there is a station on the right.
sentences.question: 駅はどこにありますか？
sentences.question_english: Where is the station?

sentences.japanese: 今月[こんげつ]の売[う]り上[あ]げはよかったです。
sentences.english: This month's sales were good.

sentences.question_english: How were this month's sales?

sentences.japanese: このお店[みせ]の売[う]り上[あ]げは毎年[まいとし]増[ふ]えています。
sentences.english: This shop's sales increase every year.

sentences.question_english: What is happening with this shop's sales?

sentences.question_english: Is there any cake?

sentences.japanese: 人気[にんき]のパンは朝[あさ]に売[う]り切[き]れになりました。
sentences.english: The popular bread sold out in the morning.
sentences.question: 人気のパンはいつ売り切れになりましたか？
sentences.question_english: When did the popular bread sell out?

sentences.japanese: 売[う]り手[て]の人[ひと]はとても親切[しんせつ]でした。
sentences.english: The seller was very kind.

sentences.question_english: What was the seller like?

sentences.japanese: 市場[いちば]には売[う]り手[て]がたくさんいます。
sentences.english: There are many sellers at the market.

sentences.question_english: What is there a lot of at the market?

sentences.japanese: 今夜[こんや]は家[いえ]で晩[ばん]ご飯[はん]を食[た]べます。

sentences.question_english: Where will they eat dinner tonight?

sentences.japanese: 今夜[こんや]は月[つき]がきれいですね。
sentences.english: The moon is beautiful tonight, isn't it.
sentences.question: 今夜は何がきれいですか？
sentences.question_english: What is beautiful tonight?

sentences.japanese: 東北[とうほく]はとても寒[さむ]い冬[ふゆ]で有名[ゆうめい]です。
sentences.english: Tohoku is famous for its very cold winters.
sentences.question: 東北は何で有名ですか？
sentences.question_english: What is Tohoku famous for?

sentences.question_english: What do children like?

sentences.question_english: What are they asking about?

sentences.question_english: What kind of person is that?

sentences.japanese: 今日[きょう]はとても気持[きも]ちがいいです。

sentences.question_english: How are you feeling today?

sentences.question_english: What is this story like?

sentences.question_english: What are the two of them arguing about?

sentences.question_english: Does he like competition?

sentences.question_english: How is this room used?

sentences.question_english: How do they go to school?

sentences.question_english: What does the younger sister like?

sentences.question_english: What is very important?

sentences.question_english: What kind of relationship do they have?

sentences.question_english: What do they want to become in the future?

sentences.question_english: What blooms when it becomes spring?

sentences.question_english: Who did they give their seat to?

sentences.question: 子どもたちは誰を囲みましたか？
sentences.question_english: Who did the children surround?

sentences.japanese: 家族[かぞく]でテーブルを囲[かこ]んで食[た]べました。
sentences.english: The family gathered around the table and ate.
sentences.question: 家族は何を囲んで食べましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did the family gather around to eat?

sentences.japanese: このカフェは雰囲気[ふんいき]がいいです。
sentences.english: This café has a nice atmosphere.
sentences.question: このカフェの雰囲気はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What is the atmosphere of this café like?

sentences.japanese: パーティーの雰囲気[ふんいき]はとても楽[たの]しかったです。
sentences.english: The atmosphere at the party was very fun.
sentences.question: パーティーの雰囲気はどうでしたか？
sentences.question_english: What was the atmosphere at the party like?

sentences.japanese: このパンは固[かた]いです。
sentences.english: This bread is hard.
sentences.question: このパンはどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What is this bread like?

sentences.japanese: この肉[にく]は固[かた]くて食[た]べにくいです。
sentences.english: This meat is tough and hard to eat.
sentences.question: この肉はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What is this meat like?

sentences.japanese: 父[ちち]はとても頑固[がんこ]です。
sentences.english: My father is very stubborn.
sentences.question: 父はどんな人ですか？
sentences.question_english: What kind of person is your father?

sentences.japanese: 彼[かれ]は頑固[がんこ]なので、意見[いけん]を変[か]えません。
sentences.english: He is stubborn, so he does not change his opinion.
sentences.question: 彼はなぜ意見を変えませんか？
sentences.question_english: Why does he not change his opinion?

sentences.japanese: 日本語[にほんご]の基本[きほん]を勉強[べんきょう]しています。
sentences.english: I am studying the basics of Japanese.
sentences.question: 何の基本を勉強していますか？
sentences.question_english: What basics are you studying?

sentences.japanese: 料理[りょうり]の基本[きほん]はとても大切[たいせつ]です。
sentences.english: The basics of cooking are very important.
sentences.question: 料理の基本はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: How important are the basics of cooking?

sentences.japanese: 日本[にほん]には四季[しき]があります。
sentences.english: Japan has four seasons.
sentences.question: 日本には何がありますか？
sentences.question_english: What does Japan have?

sentences.japanese: 四季[しき]の中[なか]で、春[はる]が一番[いちばん]好[す]きです。
sentences.english: Among the four seasons, I like spring the most.
sentences.question: 四季の中で何が一番好きですか？
sentences.question_english: Which of the four seasons do you like the most?

sentences.japanese: 宿題[しゅくだい]の完了[かんりょう]を先生[せんせい]に伝[つた]えました。
sentences.english: I told the teacher that the homework was complete.
sentences.question: 先生に何を伝えましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did you tell the teacher?

sentences.japanese: 仕事[しごと]が完了[かんりょう]しました。
sentences.english: The work is complete.
sentences.question: 何が完了しましたか？
sentences.question_english: What has been completed?

sentences.japanese: 彼女[かのじょ]の日本語[にほんご]は完全[かんぜん]です。
sentences.english: Her Japanese is perfect.
sentences.question: 彼女の日本語はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: How is her Japanese?

sentences.japanese: この計画[けいかく]は完全[かんぜん]ではありません。
sentences.english: This plan is not perfect.
sentences.question: この計画はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What is this plan like?

sentences.japanese: 絵[え]がやっと完成[かんせい]しました。
sentences.english: The painting is finally complete.
sentences.question: 何が完成しましたか？
sentences.question_english: What has been completed?

sentences.japanese: 新[あたら]しい建物[たてもの]が完成[かんせい]しました。
sentences.english: The new building has been completed.
sentences.question: 何が完成しましたか？
sentences.question_english: What has been completed?

sentences.japanese: 念願[ねんがん]の旅行[りょこう]がやっとできました。
sentences.english: I was finally able to take the trip I had always wished for.
sentences.question: 念願の何ができましたか？
sentences.question_english: What long-wished-for thing were you finally able to do?

sentences.japanese: 念願[ねんがん]だった店[みせ]を開[ひら]きました。
sentences.english: I opened the shop I had always dreamed of.
sentences.question: 何を開きましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did you open?

sentences.japanese: 試験[しけん]に合格[ごうかく]できなくて残念[ざんねん]です。
sentences.english: It is unfortunate that I could not pass the exam.
sentences.question: なぜ残念ですか？
sentences.question_english: Why is it unfortunate?

sentences.japanese: パーティーに行[い]けなくて残念[ざんねん]でした。
sentences.english: It was too bad that I could not go to the party.
sentences.question: なぜ残念でしたか？
sentences.question_english: Why was it too bad?

sentences.japanese: 人性[じんせい]について話[はな]し合[あ]いました。
sentences.english: We talked about human nature.
sentences.question: 何について話し合いましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did you talk about?

sentences.japanese: 人性[じんせい]は生[う]まれつきのものだと思[おも]います。
sentences.english: I think human nature is something you are born with.
sentences.question: 人性はどんなものだと思いますか？
sentences.question_english: What do you think human nature is?

sentences.japanese: あの女性[じょせい]は先生[せんせい]です。
sentences.english: That woman is a teacher.
sentences.question: あの女性はだれですか？
sentences.question_english: Who is that woman?

sentences.japanese: 性病[せいびょう]のことは医者[いしゃ]に相談[そうだん]してください。
sentences.english: Please consult a doctor about sexually transmitted diseases.
sentences.question: 性病について、だれに相談しますか？
sentences.question_english: Who should you consult about sexually transmitted diseases?

sentences.japanese: その男性[だんせい]は背[せ]が高[たか]いです。
sentences.english: That man is tall.
sentences.question: その男性はどんな人ですか？
sentences.question_english: What kind of person is that man?

sentences.japanese: 紙[かみ]を半分[はんぶん]に折[お]ってください。
sentences.english: Please fold the paper in half.
sentences.question: 紙をどうしますか？
sentences.question_english: What do you do with the paper?

sentences.japanese: 木[き]の枝[えだ]を折[お]りました。
sentences.english: I broke a branch off the tree.
sentences.question: 何を折りましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did you break?

sentences.japanese: 折角[せっかく]来[き]たのに、店[みせ]が閉[し]まっていました。
sentences.english: We went to the trouble of coming, but the shop was closed.
sentences.question: 店はどうでしたか？
sentences.question_english: What was the situation with the shop?

sentences.japanese: 転[ころ]んで、足[あし]を骨折[こっせつ]しました。
sentences.english: I fell and fractured my leg.
sentences.question: どうして骨折しましたか？
sentences.question_english: Why did you fracture your bone?

sentences.japanese: 試験[しけん]に落[お]ちて、失望[しつぼう]しました。
sentences.english: I failed the exam and was disappointed.
sentences.question: どうして失望しましたか？
sentences.question_english: Why were you disappointed?

sentences.japanese: 彼女[かのじょ]の望[のぞ]みは医者[いしゃ]になることです。
sentences.english: Her wish is to become a doctor.
sentences.question: 彼女の望みは何ですか？
sentences.question_english: What is her wish?

sentences.japanese: 私[わたし]は早[はや]く上手[じょうず]になることを望[のぞ]んでいます。
sentences.english: I wish to become skilled quickly.
sentences.question: 何を望んでいますか？
sentences.question_english: What are you wishing for?

sentences.japanese: 彼[かれ]の願望[がんぼう]は日本[にほん]に住[す]むことです。
sentences.english: His desire is to live in Japan.
sentences.question: 彼の願望は何ですか？
sentences.question_english: What is his desire?

sentences.japanese: この家[いえ]は木材[もくざい]で作[つく]られています。
sentences.english: This house is made of wood.
sentences.question: この家は何で作られていますか？
sentences.question_english: What is this house made of?

sentences.japanese: 料理[りょうり]の材料[ざいりょう]を買[か]いに行[い]きます。
sentences.english: I am going to buy ingredients for cooking.
sentences.question: 何を買いに行きますか？
sentences.question_english: What are you going to buy?

sentences.japanese: 材木[ざいもく]を使[つか]って、棚[たな]を作[つく]りました。

sentences.question_english: What did you use to make the shelf?

sentences.japanese: 花[はな]を一束[ひとたば]買[か]いました。
sentences.english: I bought a bunch of flowers.
sentences.question: 何を買いましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did you buy?

sentences.japanese: 友達[ともだち]と三時[さんじ]に会[あ]う約束[やくそく]をしました。
sentences.english: I made a promise to meet my friend at three o'clock.
sentences.question: 何時に約束をしましたか？
sentences.question_english: What time did you make the appointment for?

sentences.japanese: 公園[こうえん]に大[おお]きい松[まつ]の木[き]があります。
sentences.english: There is a big pine tree in the park.
sentences.question: 公園に何がありますか？
sentences.question_english: What is in the park?

sentences.japanese: お正月[しょうがつ]に家[いえ]の前[まえ]に松[まつ]をかざります。
sentences.english: We decorate with pine trees in front of the house at New Year's.
sentences.question: いつ松をかざりますか？
sentences.question_english: When do you decorate with pine trees?

sentences.japanese: 地面[じめん]に松葉[まつば]がたくさん落[お]ちています。
sentences.english: There are many pine needles fallen on the ground.
sentences.question: 地面に何が落ちていますか？
sentences.question_english: What has fallen on the ground?

sentences.japanese: 試験[しけん]に合格[ごうかく]するために、毎日[まいにち]勉強[べんきょう]しています。
sentences.english: I study every day in order to pass the exam.
sentences.question: なぜ毎日勉強していますか？
sentences.question_english: Why do you study every day?

sentences.japanese: 友達[ともだち]が大学[だいがく]に合格[ごうかく]しました。
sentences.english: My friend passed the university entrance exam.
sentences.question: 友達はどうしましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did your friend do?

sentences.japanese: 彼女[かのじょ]は明[あか]るい性格[せいかく]です。
sentences.english: She has a bright personality.
sentences.question: 彼女はどんな性格ですか？
sentences.question_english: What kind of personality does she have?

sentences.japanese: あなたの性格[せいかく]はどんなですか？
sentences.english: What is your personality like?
sentences.question: 何について聞いていますか？
sentences.question_english: What are they asking about?

sentences.japanese: ケーキの残[のこ]りを冷蔵庫[れいぞうこ]に入[い]れました。
sentences.english: I put the leftover cake in the refrigerator.
sentences.question: 残りのケーキをどこに入れましたか？
sentences.question_english: Where did you put the leftover cake?

sentences.japanese: 時間[じかん]の残[のこ]りはあと五分[ごふん]です。
sentences.english: There are only five minutes remaining.
sentences.question: 残りの時間はどのくらいですか？
sentences.question_english: How much time is remaining?

sentences.japanese: 友達[ともだち]はみんな帰[かえ]りましたが、私[わたし]だけ残[のこ]りました。
sentences.english: All my friends went home, but only I stayed behind.
sentences.question: 友達はどうしましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did the friends do?

sentences.japanese: お皿[さら]にご飯[はん]が少[すこ]し残[のこ]っています。
sentences.english: A little rice remains on the plate.
sentences.question: お皿に何が残っていますか？
sentences.question_english: What remains on the plate?

sentences.japanese: 今日[きょう]は残業[ざんぎょう]があるので、帰[かえ]るのが遅[おそ]くなります。
sentences.english: I have overtime today, so I will be late coming home.
sentences.question: なぜ帰るのが遅くなりますか？
sentences.question_english: Why will you be late coming home?

sentences.japanese: 昨日[きのう]は二時間[にじかん]残業[ざんぎょう]しました。
sentences.english: Yesterday I worked two hours of overtime.
sentences.question: 昨日何時間残業しましたか？
sentences.question_english: How many hours of overtime did you work yesterday?

sentences.japanese: 母[はは]は料理[りょうり]がとても上手[じょうず]です。
sentences.english: My mother is very good at cooking.
sentences.question: お母さんは料理が上手ですか？
sentences.question_english: Is your mother good at cooking?

sentences.japanese: 好[す]きな料理[りょうり]は何[なん]ですか？
sentences.english: What is your favorite dish?
sentences.question: 何について聞いていますか？
sentences.question_english: What are they asking about?

sentences.japanese: この映画[えいが]はロマンティック的[てき]なストーリーです。
sentences.english: This movie has a romantic-like story.
sentences.question: この映画はどんなストーリーですか？
sentences.question_english: What kind of story does this movie have?

sentences.japanese: 科学[かがく]的[てき]な考[かんが]え方[かた]が大切[たいせつ]です。
sentences.english: A scientific way of thinking is important.
sentences.question: どんな考え方が大切ですか？
sentences.question_english: What kind of thinking is important?

sentences.japanese: お辞儀[じぎ]はとても日本的[にほんてき]なあいさつです。

sentences.question_english: What kind of greeting is bowing?

sentences.japanese: この庭[にわ]のデザインはとても日本的[にほんてき]です。
sentences.english: The design of this garden is very Japanese.
sentences.question: この庭はどんなデザインですか？
sentences.question_english: What kind of design does this garden have?

sentences.japanese: 日本[にほん]に来[き]た目的[もくてき]は何[なん]ですか？
sentences.english: What is your purpose for coming to Japan?
sentences.question: 何について聞いていますか？
sentences.question_english: What are they asking about?

sentences.question: あなたの目的は何ですか？
sentences.question_english: What is your goal?

sentences.question: 何の予約について聞いていますか？
sentences.question_english: What reservation are they asking about?

sentences.english: My hospital appointment is at three o'clock.
sentences.question: 病院の予約は何時ですか？
sentences.question_english: What time is the hospital appointment?

sentences.japanese: 駅[えき]まで約[やく]十分[じゅっぷん]かかります。
sentences.english: It takes about ten minutes to the station.
sentences.question: 駅まで何分かかりますか？
sentences.question_english: How many minutes does it take to the station?

sentences.japanese: このクラスには約[やく]三十人[さんじゅうにん]の学生[がくせい]がいます。
sentences.english: There are about thirty students in this class.
sentences.question: このクラスに学生は何人いますか？
sentences.question_english: How many students are in this class?

sentences.japanese: 彼[かれ]は音楽[おんがく]の才能[さいのう]があります。
sentences.english: He has a talent for music.
sentences.question: 彼はどんな才能がありますか？
sentences.question_english: What kind of talent does he have?

sentences.japanese: あなたには絵[え]を描[か]く才能[さいのう]があると思[おも]います。
sentences.english: I think you have a talent for drawing pictures.
sentences.question: どんな才能があると言っていますか？
sentences.question_english: What talent are they saying you have?

sentences.japanese: 彼女[かのじょ]は日本語[にほんご]の能力[のうりょく]がとても高[たか]いです。
sentences.english: Her Japanese language ability is very high.
sentences.question: 彼女はどんな能力がありますか？
sentences.question_english: What kind of ability does she have?

sentences.japanese: 自分[じぶん]の能力[のうりょく]を信[しん]じてください。
sentences.english: Please believe in your own abilities.
sentences.question: 何を信じてほしいですか？
sentences.question_english: What do they want you to believe in?

sentences.japanese: 彼女[かのじょ]は芸能界[げいのうかい]で働[はたら]いています。
sentences.english: She works in the entertainment industry.
sentences.question: 彼女はどこで働いていますか？
sentences.question_english: Where does she work?

sentences.japanese: あの芸人[げいにん]はとても面白[おもしろ]いです。
sentences.english: That comedian is very funny.
sentences.question: あの芸人はどんな人ですか？
sentences.question_english: What kind of person is that comedian?

sentences.japanese: 芸者[げいしゃ]は日本[にほん]の文化[ぶんか]です。
sentences.english: Geisha are part of Japanese culture.
sentences.question: 芸者は何の文化ですか？
sentences.question_english: Whose culture are geisha part of?

sentences.japanese: 転[ころ]んで骨[ほね]が痛[いた]いです。
sentences.english: I fell down and my bone hurts.
sentences.question: どうして骨が痛いですか？
sentences.question_english: Why does the bone hurt?

sentences.japanese: 深[ふか]く息[いき]を吸[す]って、落[お]ち着[つ]いてください。
sentences.english: Please breathe deeply and calm down.
sentences.question: どうやって落ち着きますか？
sentences.question_english: How do you calm down?

sentences.japanese: 試験[しけん]の前[まえ]に少[すこ]し落[お]ち着[つ]きました。
sentences.english: I calmed down a little before the exam.
sentences.question: いつ落ち着きましたか？
sentences.question_english: When did you calm down?

sentences.japanese: 食[た]べた後[あと]、ゆっくり消化[しょうか]します。
sentences.english: After eating, I digest slowly.

sentences.question_english: When do you digest?

sentences.japanese: 電気[でんき]が消[き]えました。
sentences.english: The light went out.
sentences.question: 何が消えましたか？
sentences.question_english: What went out?

sentences.japanese: ろうそくの火[ひ]が消[き]えました。
sentences.english: The candle flame went out.

sentences.question_english: Whose flame went out?

sentences.japanese: この魚[さかな]は気持[きも]ち悪[わる]い味[あじ]がします。
sentences.english: This fish tastes terrible.
sentences.question: この魚の味はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: How does this fish taste?

sentences.japanese: バスの中[なか]で気持[きも]ち悪[わる]くなりました。
sentences.english: I started feeling sick inside the bus.

sentences.question_english: Where did you start feeling sick?

sentences.english: Water is flowing in the river.
sentences.question: どこに水が流れていますか？
sentences.question_english: Where is the water flowing?

sentences.japanese: この箱[はこ]を部屋[へや]の外[そと]に動[うご]かしてください。

sentences.question_english: When did you put on your hat?

sentences.question_english: What do you study every evening?

sentences.english: I like studying at the library.
sentences.question: どこで勉強するのが好きですか？
sentences.question_english: Where do you like to study?

sentences.japanese: 来年[らいねん]、家族[かぞく]と日本[にほん]を旅行[りょこう]したいです。
sentences.english: Next year, I want to travel to Japan with my family.
sentences.question: 誰と旅行したいですか？
sentences.question_english: Who do you want to travel with?

sentences.japanese: この時計[とけい]は高[たか]いですか？

sentences.question_english: What is this watch like?

sentences.japanese: 時計[とけい]を見[み]てください。今[いま]、三時[さんじ]です。

sentences.japanese: 合計[ごうけい]はいくらですか？

sentences.question_english: What are they asking about?

sentences.japanese: 合計[ごうけい]で五百円[ごひゃくえん]です。

sentences.question: 合計はいくらですか？
sentences.question_english: What is the total amount?

sentences.japanese: 来月[らいげつ]の旅行[りょこう]の計画[けいかく]を立[た]てました。

sentences.japanese: 計算[けいさん]が難[むずか]しいです。

sentences.question_english: How is the calculation?

sentences.japanese: 電卓[でんたく]で計算[けいさん]しました。

sentences.question_english: What did you use to calculate?

sentences.japanese: 父[ちち]は軍人[ぐんじん]です。

sentences.question: 父の仕事は何ですか？
sentences.question_english: What is your father's job?

sentences.japanese: 兄[あに]は海軍[かいぐん]で働[はたら]いています。
sentences.english: My older brother works in the navy.
sentences.question: 兄はどこで働いていますか？
sentences.question_english: Where does your older brother work?

sentences.japanese: 飯[めし]はもう食[た]べましたか？
sentences.english: Have you already eaten your meal?

sentences.japanese: 朝[あさ]の飯[めし]はパンです。
sentences.english: Breakfast is bread.
sentences.question: 朝の飯は何ですか？
sentences.question_english: What is breakfast?

sentences.japanese: 毎朝[まいあさ]、ご飯[ごはん]を食[た]べます。
sentences.english: I eat a meal every morning.
sentences.question: いつご飯を食べますか？
sentences.question_english: When do you eat a meal?

sentences.japanese: ご飯[ごはん]はもう準備[じゅんび]できています。

sentences.question_english: What is the status of the meal?

sentences.japanese: 私[わたし]は不器用[ぶきよう]なので、よく物[もの]を落[お]とします。
sentences.english: Because I am clumsy, I often drop things.
sentences.question: なぜよく物を落としますか？
sentences.question_english: Why do you often drop things?

sentences.japanese: 彼[かれ]は手[て]が不器用[ぶきよう]で、折[お]り紙[がみ]が上手[じょうず]ではありません。

sentences.question: 彼は折り紙が上手ですか？
sentences.question_english: Is he good at origami?

sentences.japanese: 一[ひと]つお願[ねが]いがあります。駅[えき]まで送[おく]ってもらえますか？
sentences.english: I have a request. Could you take me to the station?
sentences.question: どんなお願いがありますか？
sentences.question_english: What is the request?

sentences.japanese: お願[ねが]いだから、静[しず]かにしてください。
sentences.english: Please, I am asking you to be quiet.
sentences.question: 何をお願いしていますか？
sentences.question_english: What are they requesting?

sentences.japanese: このお店[みせ]は飲[の]み放題[ほうだい]で、二千円[にせんえん]です。
sentences.english: This restaurant has all-you-can-drink for 2,000 yen.
sentences.question: 飲み放題はいくらですか？
sentences.question_english: How much is the all-you-can-drink?

sentences.japanese: 飲[の]み放題[ほうだい]のコースを注文[ちゅうもん]しました。
sentences.english: I ordered the all-you-can-drink course.
sentences.question: どんなコースを注文しましたか？
sentences.question_english: What kind of course did they order?

sentences.japanese: あのレストランは食[た]べ放題[ほうだい]なので、人気[にんき]があります。
sentences.english: That restaurant is popular because it is all-you-can-eat.
sentences.question: なぜそのレストランは人気がありますか？
sentences.question_english: Why is that restaurant popular?

sentences.japanese: 友達[ともだち]と食[た]べ放題[ほうだい]のお寿司[すし]屋[や]に行[い]きました。
sentences.english: I went to an all-you-can-eat sushi restaurant with my friends.
sentences.question: どこに行きましたか？
sentences.question_english: Where did they go?

sentences.japanese: ニュースで人殺[ひとごろ]しの話[はなし]を聞[き]きました。
sentences.english: I heard a story about a murder on the news.
sentences.question: どこで人殺しの話を聞きましたか？
sentences.question_english: Where did you hear the story about the murder?

sentences.japanese: 警察[けいさつ]は殺人者[さつじんしゃ]を探[さが]しています。
sentences.english: The police are searching for the murderer.
sentences.question: 警察は何をしていますか？
sentences.question_english: What are the police doing?

sentences.japanese: 彼女[かのじょ]は指輪[ゆびわ]をもらって、とても喜[よろこ]びました。
sentences.english: She was very happy to receive a ring.
sentences.question: 彼女は何をもらいましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did she receive?

sentences.japanese: この指輪[ゆびわ]はどこで買[か]いましたか？
sentences.english: Where did you buy this ring?
sentences.question: 何について聞いていますか？
sentences.question_english: What are they asking about?

sentences.japanese: 輪[わ]ゴムで紙[かみ]をまとめてください。
sentences.english: Please bundle the papers together with a rubber band.

sentences.question_english: What do you use to bundle the papers?

sentences.japanese: 机[つくえ]の上[うえ]に輪[わ]ゴムがありますか？
sentences.english: Is there a rubber band on the desk?
sentences.question: 何について聞いていますか？
sentences.question_english: What are they asking about?

sentences.japanese: 試験[しけん]のために漢字[かんじ]を暗記[あんき]しています。

sentences.question: なぜ漢字を暗記していますか？
sentences.question_english: Why are you memorizing kanji?

sentences.japanese: この単語[たんご]を暗記[あんき]するのは難[むずか]しいです。
sentences.english: It is difficult to memorize this vocabulary word.
sentences.question: この単語を暗記するのはどうですか？
sentences.question_english: How is it to memorize this vocabulary word?

sentences.japanese: 毎日[まいにち]ピアノを練習[れんしゅう]しています。
sentences.english: I practice piano every day.
sentences.question: 何を毎日練習していますか？
sentences.question_english: What do you practice every day?

sentences.japanese: もっと練習[れんしゅう]すれば、上手[じょうず]になりますよ。
sentences.english: If you practice more, you will get better.
sentences.question: どうすれば上手になりますか？
sentences.question_english: What do you need to do to get better?

sentences.japanese: 試験[しけん]に不合格[ふごうかく]になってしまいました。
sentences.english: I ended up failing the exam.
sentences.question: 試験の結果はどうでしたか？
sentences.question_english: What was the result of the exam?

sentences.japanese: 不合格[ふごうかく]でも、あきらめないでください。
sentences.english: Even if you fail, please do not give up.
sentences.question: 不合格になったら、どうすればいいですか？
sentences.question_english: What should you do if you fail?

sentences.japanese: 昨日[きのう]、町[まち]で変事[へんじ]が起[お]きました。
sentences.english: Yesterday, an unexpected incident occurred in town.
sentences.question: いつ変事が起きましたか？
sentences.question_english: When did the unexpected incident occur?

sentences.japanese: 今[いま]、スマホが同期中[どうきちゅう]です。少[すこ]し待[ま]ってください。
sentences.english: My smartphone is currently syncing. Please wait a moment.
sentences.question: なぜ少し待たなければなりませんか？
sentences.question_english: Why do you have to wait a moment?

sentences.japanese: データが同期中[どうきちゅう]なので、使[つか]えません。
sentences.english: I cannot use it because the data is syncing.
sentences.question: なぜ使えませんか？
sentences.question_english: Why can't it be used?

sentences.japanese: あの古[ふる]いお寺[てら]はとても有名[ゆうめい]です。
sentences.english: That old temple is very famous.
sentences.question: あのお寺はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What is that temple like?

sentences.japanese: 週末[しゅうまつ]に友達[ともだち]とお寺[てら]に行[い]きました。
sentences.english: I went to a temple with my friends on the weekend.
sentences.question: 週末に誰とお寺に行きましたか？
sentences.question_english: Who did you go to the temple with on the weekend?

sentences.japanese: 速[はや]さと時間[じかん]は比例[ひれい]しています。

sentences.question: 何[なに]と何[なに]が比例[ひれい]していますか？
sentences.question_english: What is proportional to what?

sentences.japanese: むずかしい問題[もんだい]がやっと解[と]けました。

sentences.question_english: What happened to the problem?

sentences.japanese: このケーキはとても美味[おい]しいです。

sentences.japanese: お母[かあ]さんの料理[りょうり]はいつも美味[おい]しいです。

sentences.question_english: How is mom's cooking?

sentences.question_english: What time will they come?

sentences.japanese: レジでお金[かね]を払[はら]いました。

sentences.question_english: What did they change?

sentences.question_english: What kind of shoes are these?

sentences.japanese: 体[からだ]が丈夫[じょうぶ]なので、あまり病気[びょうき]になりません。

sentences.question_english: Why don't they get sick very often?

sentences.question_english: How is the length of these pants?

sentences.japanese: このかばんは頑丈[がんじょう]でとても重[おも]いものも入[い]れられます。

sentences.question_english: What kind of bag is this?

sentences.english: This desk is sturdy, so it won't break.

sentences.question_english: Why won't this desk break?

sentences.japanese: テストでいい点[てん]をとって、みんなを見返[みかえ]したいです。
sentences.english: I want to get a good score on the test and show everyone what I can do.

sentences.japanese: その国[くに]の軍[ぐん]はとても強[つよ]いです。

sentences.japanese: 友達[ともだち]の伝[つて]でその会社[かいしゃ]に入[はい]ることができました。

sentences.question_english: How did they get into that company?

sentences.japanese: テストで０点[てん]を取[と]るなんて、情[なさ]けないなあ。

sentences.question_english: Why do they think it is shameful?

sentences.question_english: What are the flowers emitting?

sentences.japanese: 朝[あさ]、部屋[へや]を整[ととの]えてから学校[がっこう]に行[い]きます。

sentences.question_english: When do they tidy up their room?

sentences.question_english: What did they put in order?

sentences.question_english: How long is the lunch break?

sentences.question_english: Why are they going to the park?

sentences.question_english: What will tomorrow's weather be like?

sentences.question_english: When did they travel to Japan?

sentences.question_english: What should you do before entering?

sentences.question: 気象庁は明日の天気をどう言っていますか？
sentences.question_english: What does the Meteorological Agency say about tomorrow's weather?

sentences.japanese: 気象庁[きしょうちょう] の 予報[よほう] によると、 今週[こんしゅう] は 晴[は] れです。
sentences.english: According to the Meteorological Agency's forecast, it will be sunny this week.
sentences.question: 今週の天気はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What is the weather like this week?

sentences.japanese: この 建物[たてもの] の 構造[こうぞう] は とても 丈夫[じょうぶ] です。
sentences.english: The structure of this building is very strong.
sentences.question: この建物の構造はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What is the structure of this building like?

sentences.japanese: 先生[せんせい] は 文[ぶん] の 構造[こうぞう] を 説明[せつめい] しました。
sentences.english: The teacher explained the structure of the sentence.
sentences.question: 先生は何を説明しましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did the teacher explain?

sentences.japanese: 工事[こうじ] が 終[お] わって、 駅[えき] が 再開[さいかい] しました。
sentences.english: The construction ended and the station reopened.
sentences.question: なぜ駅が再開しましたか？
sentences.question_english: Why did the station reopen?

sentences.japanese: 休憩[きゅうけい] の 後[あと] で、 授業[じゅぎょう] が 再開[さいかい] しました。
sentences.english: After the break, the class resumed.
sentences.question: 休憩の後で何が再開しましたか？
sentences.question_english: What resumed after the break?

sentences.japanese: 再度[さいど] 確認[かくにん] してください。
sentences.english: Please check again.
sentences.question: 何をしてくださいと言いましたか？
sentences.question_english: What were you asked to do?

sentences.japanese: 再度[さいど] 試[ため] してみます。
sentences.english: I will try again one more time.
sentences.question: もう一度何をしますか？
sentences.question_english: What will you do one more time?

sentences.japanese: 新[あたら] しい 本[ほん] を 読[よ] むと、 刺激[しげき] になります。
sentences.english: Reading new books is stimulating.
sentences.question: 何が刺激になりますか？
sentences.question_english: What is stimulating?

sentences.japanese: 旅行[りょこう] は いい 刺激[しげき] になります。
sentences.english: Travel is good stimulation.
sentences.question: 何がいい刺激になりますか？
sentences.question_english: What is good stimulation?

sentences.japanese: 子[こ]どもは新[あたら]しいものを創造[そうぞう]するのが好[す]きです。
sentences.english: Children like to create new things.
sentences.question: 子どもは何をするのが好きですか？
sentences.question_english: What do children like to do?

sentences.japanese: この学校[がっこう]の創立[そうりつ]は百年[ひゃくねん]前[まえ]です。
sentences.english: This school was founded one hundred years ago.
sentences.question: この学校の創立はいつですか？
sentences.question_english: When was this school founded?

sentences.japanese: 先生[せんせい]は試験[しけん]の前[まえ]に学生[がくせい]に激励[げきれい]のことばをかけました。
sentences.english: The teacher gave the students words of encouragement before the exam.
sentences.question: 先生はいつ激励のことばをかけましたか？
sentences.question_english: When did the teacher give words of encouragement?

sentences.japanese: 友[とも]だちが悲[かな]しそうだったので、励[はげ]ましました。
sentences.english: My friend seemed sad, so I encouraged them.
sentences.question: どうして友だちを励ましましたか？
sentences.question_english: Why did you encourage your friend?

sentences.japanese: 駅[えき]の近[ちか]くに占[うらな]いの店[みせ]があります。
sentences.english: There is a fortune telling shop near the station.
sentences.question: 占いの店はどこにありますか？
sentences.question_english: Where is the fortune telling shop?

sentences.japanese: このクラスでは女性[じょせい]が半分[はんぶん]以上[いじょう]を占[し]めています。
sentences.english: Women make up more than half of this class.
sentences.question: このクラスで女性は何を占めていますか？
sentences.question_english: What do women account for in this class?

sentences.japanese: あの会社[かいしゃ]はこの町[まち]の市場[いちば]を独占[どくせん]しています。
sentences.english: That company monopolizes the market in this town.
sentences.question: あの会社は何を独占していますか？
sentences.question_english: What does that company monopolize?

sentences.japanese: 地図[ちず]にこの印[しるし]は何[なに]ですか？
sentences.english: What is this mark on the map?
sentences.question: 地図の印は何ですか？
sentences.question_english: What is the mark on the map?

sentences.japanese: 第一印象[だいいちいんしょう]はとても大切[たいせつ]だと思[おも]います。
sentences.english: I think first impressions are very important.
sentences.question: 何が大切だと思いますか？
sentences.question_english: What do you think is important?

sentences.japanese: 荷物[にもつ]を家[いえ]まで届[とど]けてもらいました。
sentences.english: I had my luggage delivered to my house.
sentences.question: 荷物をどこに届けてもらいましたか？
sentences.question_english: Where did you have your luggage delivered?

sentences.japanese: 人[ひと]を差別[さべつ]することはよくないです。
sentences.english: It is not good to discriminate against people.
sentences.question: 何がよくないですか？
sentences.question_english: What is not good?

sentences.japanese: 人差[ひとさ]し指[ゆび]で地図[ちず]の場所[ばしょ]を指[さ]しました。
sentences.english: I pointed to the location on the map with my index finger.
sentences.question: 何で地図の場所を指しましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did you use to point to the location on the map?

sentences.japanese: 先生[せんせい]にプレゼントを差[さ]し上[あ]げました。
sentences.english: I gave a present to my teacher.
sentences.question: だれにプレゼントを差し上げましたか？
sentences.question_english: Who did you give the present to?

sentences.japanese: 東京[とうきょう]から大阪[おおさか]までの往復[おうふく]の切符[きっぷ]を買[か]いました。
sentences.english: I bought a round trip ticket from Tokyo to Osaka.
sentences.question: どんな切符を買いましたか？
sentences.question_english: What kind of ticket did you buy?

sentences.japanese: 学校[がっこう]では先生[せんせい]のルールに従[したが]わなければなりません。
sentences.english: At school, you must follow the teacher's rules.
sentences.question: 学校では何に従わなければなりませんか？
sentences.question_english: What must you follow at school?

sentences.japanese: 従来[じゅうらい]のやり方[かた]は少[すこ]し古[ふる]いです。
sentences.english: The conventional way of doing things is a little old.
sentences.question: 従来のやり方はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What is the conventional way of doing things like?

sentences.japanese: テストの前[まえ]に復習[ふくしゅう]をします。
sentences.english: I review before the test.
sentences.question: いつ復習をしますか？
sentences.question_english: When do you review?

sentences.japanese: 昨日[きのう]の授業[じゅぎょう]を復習[ふくしゅう]しました。
sentences.english: I reviewed yesterday's lesson.
sentences.question: 何を復習しましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did you review?

sentences.japanese: 病気[びょうき]からの回復[かいふく]に時間[じかん]がかかります。
sentences.english: Recovery from illness takes time.
sentences.question: 何からの回復ですか？
sentences.question_english: Recovery from what?

sentences.japanese: 彼女[かのじょ]は手術[しゅじゅつ]の後[あと]、早[はや]く回復[かいふく]しました。
sentences.english: She recovered quickly after the surgery.
sentences.question: 彼女はいつ回復しましたか？
sentences.question_english: When did she recover?

sentences.japanese: この猫[ねこ]の特徴[とくちょう]は白[しろ]い耳[みみ]です。
sentences.english: The distinctive feature of this cat is its white ears.
sentences.question: この猫の特徴は何ですか？
sentences.question_english: What is the distinctive feature of this cat?

sentences.japanese: 桜[さくら]は日本[にほん]の象徴[しょうちょう]です。
sentences.english: Cherry blossoms are a symbol of Japan.
sentences.question: 桜は何の象徴ですか？
sentences.question_english: What are cherry blossoms a symbol of?

sentences.japanese: あの人[ひと]は少[すこ]し怪[あや]しいです。
sentences.english: That person is a little suspicious.
sentences.question: あの人はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What is that person like?

sentences.japanese: 空[そら]の色[いろ]が怪[あや]しいので、傘[かさ]を持[も]っていきます。
sentences.english: The color of the sky looks suspicious, so I will bring an umbrella.
sentences.question: なぜ傘を持っていきますか？
sentences.question_english: Why are you bringing an umbrella?

sentences.japanese: テレビで怪事件[かいじけん]のニュースを見[み]ました。
sentences.english: I watched news about a mystery case on TV.
sentences.question: テレビで何を見ましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did you watch on TV?

sentences.japanese: 夏[なつ]に友達[ともだち]と怪談[かいだん]を話[はな]しました。
sentences.english: I told ghost stories with my friends in summer.
sentences.question: いつ怪談を話しましたか？
sentences.question_english: When did you tell ghost stories?

sentences.japanese: 怪談[かいだん]を聞[き]いて、こわくなりました。
sentences.english: I listened to a ghost story and became scared.
sentences.question: 怪談を聞いてどうなりましたか？
sentences.question_english: How did you feel after listening to the ghost story?

sentences.japanese: 我[われ]は毎日[まいにち]日本語[にほんご]を勉強[べんきょう]します。
sentences.english: I study Japanese every day.
sentences.question: 何を毎日しますか？
sentences.question_english: What do you do every day?

sentences.japanese: 無我[むが]の気持[きも]ちで仕事[しごと]をしました。
sentences.english: I worked with a selfless spirit.
sentences.question: どんな気持ちで仕事をしましたか？
sentences.question_english: With what feeling did you work?

sentences.japanese: 彼[かれ]はクラスのリーダーとして責任[せきにん]を担[にな]っています。
sentences.english: He is taking on responsibility as the class leader.
sentences.question: 彼はどんな役割を担っていますか？
sentences.question_english: What role is he taking on?

sentences.japanese: 友達[ともだち]に手[て]を振[ふ]りました。
sentences.english: I waved my hand to my friend.
sentences.question: 誰に手を振りましたか？
sentences.question_english: Who did you wave your hand to?

sentences.japanese: 子供[こども]は旗[はた]を振[ふ]っています。
sentences.english: The child is waving a flag.
sentences.question: 子供は何を振っていますか？
sentences.question_english: What is the child waving?

sentences.japanese: 電車[でんしゃ]の振動[しんどう]で目[め]が覚[さ]めました。
sentences.english: I woke up from the vibration of the train.
sentences.question: 何で目が覚めましたか？
sentences.question_english: What woke you up?

sentences.japanese: 今日[きょう]の授業[じゅぎょう]は九時[くじ]に始[はじ]まります。
sentences.english: Today's class starts at nine o'clock.
sentences.question: 今日の授業は何時に始まりますか？
sentences.question_english: What time does today's class start?

sentences.japanese: 授業[じゅぎょう]の後[あと]で図書館[としょかん]に行[い]きます。
sentences.english: I will go to the library after class.
sentences.question: 授業の後でどこに行きますか？
sentences.question_english: Where are you going after class?

sentences.japanese: 田中[たなか]先生[せんせい]は大学[だいがく]の教授[きょうじゅ]です。
sentences.english: Mr. Tanaka is a university professor.
sentences.question: 田中先生は何ですか？
sentences.question_english: What is Mr. Tanaka?

sentences.japanese: 教授[きょうじゅ]の授業[じゅぎょう]はとても面白[おもしろ]いです。
sentences.english: The professor's class is very interesting.
sentences.question: 教授の授業はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What is the professor's class like?

sentences.japanese: 先生[せんせい]に直接[ちょくせつ]聞[き]いてください。
sentences.english: Please ask the teacher directly.
sentences.question: だれに聞きますか？
sentences.question_english: Who do you ask?

sentences.japanese: 駅[えき]から直接[ちょくせつ]家[いえ]に帰[かえ]ります。
sentences.english: I will go home directly from the station.
sentences.question: どこから帰りますか？
sentences.question_english: Where do you go home from?

sentences.japanese: 友達[ともだち]を通[とお]して間接[かんせつ]的[てき]に話[はな]しました。
sentences.english: I spoke indirectly through a friend.
sentences.question: どうやって話しましたか？
sentences.question_english: How did you speak?

sentences.japanese: 明日[あした]、会社[かいしゃ]の面接[めんせつ]があります。
sentences.english: Tomorrow I have a job interview at a company.
sentences.question: 明日、何がありますか？
sentences.question_english: What is there tomorrow?

sentences.japanese: 面接[めんせつ]の前[まえ]に、練習[れんしゅう]をしました。
sentences.english: I practiced before the interview.
sentences.question: いつ練習をしましたか？
sentences.question_english: When did you practice?

sentences.japanese: 今朝[けさ]、道[みち]で事故[じこ]がありました。
sentences.english: This morning there was an accident on the road.
sentences.question: どこで事故がありましたか？
sentences.question_english: Where was the accident?

sentences.japanese: 事故[じこ]のせいで、電車[でんしゃ]が遅[おく]れました。
sentences.english: The train was late because of an accident.
sentences.question: なぜ電車が遅れましたか？
sentences.question_english: Why was the train late?

sentences.japanese: エレベーターが故障[こしょう]しています。
sentences.english: The elevator is out of order.
sentences.question: エレベーターはどうなっていますか？
sentences.question_english: What is wrong with the elevator?

sentences.japanese: 車[くるま]が故障[こしょう]して、会社[かいしゃ]に遅[おく]れました。
sentences.english: My car broke down and I was late to work.
sentences.question: なぜ会社に遅れましたか？
sentences.question_english: Why were you late to work?

sentences.japanese: それは故意[こい]にやったことではありません。
sentences.english: That was not something done on purpose.
sentences.question: それは故意にやりましたか？
sentences.question_english: Was that done on purpose?

sentences.japanese: 父[ちち]は大[おお]きい株式会社[かぶしきがいしゃ]で働[はたら]いています。
sentences.english: My father works at a large corporation.
sentences.question: お父さんはどこで働いていますか？
sentences.question_english: Where does your father work?

sentences.japanese: 今日[きょう]、株式市場[かぶしきしじょう]は上[あ]がりました。
sentences.english: The stock market went up today.
sentences.question: 今日、株式市場はどうなりましたか？
sentences.question_english: What happened to the stock market today?

sentences.japanese: 二[ふた]つの店[みせ]の値段[ねだん]を比較[ひかく]しました。
sentences.english: I compared the prices of two stores.
sentences.question: 何を比較しましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did you compare?

sentences.japanese: 去年[きょねん]と比較[ひかく]すると、今年[ことし]は暑[あつ]いです。
sentences.english: Compared to last year, this year is hot.
sentences.question: 今年はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: How is this year?

sentences.japanese: 走[はし]った後[あと]、汗[あせ]をたくさんかきました。
sentences.english: After running, I sweated a lot.
sentences.question: いつ汗をかきましたか？
sentences.question_english: When did you sweat?

sentences.japanese: 暑[あつ]いので、汗[あせ]が出[で]ています。
sentences.english: Because it is hot, I am sweating.
sentences.question: なぜ汗が出ていますか？
sentences.question_english: Why are you sweating?

sentences.japanese: 運動[うんどう]した後[あと]、シャツが汗臭[あせくさ]いです。
sentences.english: After exercising, my shirt smells like sweat.
sentences.question: シャツはどんなにおいがしますか？
sentences.question_english: What does the shirt smell like?

sentences.japanese: この河[かわ]はとても大[おお]きいです。
sentences.english: This river is very large.
sentences.question: この河はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What is this river like?

sentences.japanese: 子供[こども]のころ、よく河[かわ]で遊[あそ]びました。
sentences.english: When I was a child, I often played by the river.
sentences.question: 子供のころ、どこで遊びましたか？
sentences.question_english: Where did you play when you were a child?

sentences.japanese: 河童[かっぱ]は日本[にほん]の昔話[むかしばなし]に出[で]てきます。
sentences.english: Kappa appear in Japanese folktales.
sentences.question: 河童はどこに出てきますか？
sentences.question_english: Where do kappa appear?

sentences.japanese: 子供[こども]のころ、河童[かっぱ]の話[はなし]を聞[き]きました。
sentences.english: When I was a child, I heard stories about kappa.
sentences.question: 子供のころ、何の話を聞きましたか？
sentences.question_english: What stories did you hear as a child?

sentences.japanese: 写真[しゃしん]で氷河[ひょうが]を見[み]ました。とても大[おお]きかったです。
sentences.english: I saw a glacier in a photo. It was very large.
sentences.question: 氷河はどうでしたか？
sentences.question_english: What was the glacier like?

sentences.japanese: この運河[うんが]はとても古[ふる]いです。
sentences.english: This canal is very old.
sentences.question: この運河はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What is this canal like?

sentences.japanese: 運河[うんが]のそばを散歩[さんぽ]しました。
sentences.english: I took a walk along the canal.
sentences.question: どこを散歩しましたか？
sentences.question_english: Where did you take a walk?

sentences.japanese: 河豚[ふぐ]は高[たか]い魚[さかな]です。
sentences.english: Fugu is an expensive fish.
sentences.question: 河豚[ふぐ]はどんな魚[さかな]ですか？
sentences.question_english: What kind of fish is fugu?

sentences.japanese: 日本[にほん]で河豚[ふぐ]を食[た]べました。
sentences.english: I ate fugu in Japan.
sentences.question: どこで河豚[ふぐ]を食[た]べましたか？
sentences.question_english: Where did you eat fugu?

sentences.japanese: 今日[きょう]は雨[あめ]が激[はげ]しいです。
sentences.english: The rain is intense today.
sentences.question: 今日[きょう]の雨[あめ]はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: How is the rain today?

sentences.japanese: 昨日[きのう]、風[かぜ]が激[はげ]しかったです。
sentences.english: Yesterday the wind was fierce.
sentences.question: 昨日[きのう]、天気[てんき]はどうでしたか？
sentences.question_english: How was the weather yesterday?

sentences.japanese: 木[き]が燃[も]えています。
sentences.english: The tree is on fire.
sentences.question: 何[なに]が燃[も]えていますか？
sentences.question_english: What is burning?

sentences.japanese: 紙[かみ]はすぐ燃[も]えます。
sentences.english: Paper burns quickly.
sentences.question: 紙[かみ]はどのように燃[も]えますか？
sentences.question_english: How does paper burn?

sentences.japanese: マッチで紙[かみ]が燃[も]え付[つ]きました。
sentences.english: The paper caught fire from a match.
sentences.question: 何[なに]で紙[かみ]が燃[も]え付[つ]きましたか？
sentences.question_english: What made the paper catch fire?

sentences.japanese: カーテンが燃[も]え付[つ]いて、こわかったです。
sentences.english: The curtain caught fire and it was scary.
sentences.question: 何[なに]が燃[も]え付[つ]きましたか？
sentences.question_english: What caught fire?

sentences.japanese: 今日[きょう]は独[ひと]りで昼[ひる]ごはんを食[た]べました。
sentences.english: Today I ate lunch alone.
sentences.question: だれと昼[ひる]ごはんを食[た]べましたか？
sentences.question_english: Who did you eat lunch with?

sentences.japanese: 独[ひと]りで映画[えいが]を見[み]るのが好[す]きです。
sentences.english: I like watching movies alone.
sentences.question: 何[なに]をするのが好[す]きですか？
sentences.question_english: What do you like to do?

sentences.japanese: 兄[あに]はまだ独身[どくしん]です。
sentences.english: My older brother is still single.
sentences.question: 兄[あに]は結婚[けっこん]していますか？
sentences.question_english: Is your older brother married?

sentences.japanese: 独身[どくしん]の時[とき]は自由[じゆう]でした。
sentences.english: When I was single, I was free.
sentences.question: 独身[どくしん]の時[とき]はどうでしたか？
sentences.question_english: What was it like when you were single?

sentences.english: I am looking for my key inside my bag.
sentences.question: 何を探していますか？
sentences.question_english: What are you looking for?

sentences.japanese: いい レストランを 探[さが]したいです。
sentences.english: I want to look for a good restaurant.
sentences.question: 何を探したいですか？
sentences.question_english: What do you want to look for?

sentences.japanese: 彼女[かのじょ]は 科学[かがく]の 探究[たんきゅう]が 好[す]きです。
sentences.english: She likes academic inquiry into science.
sentences.question: 彼女は何の探究が好きですか？
sentences.question_english: What kind of inquiry does she like?

sentences.japanese: あの 映画[えいが]の 主人公[しゅじんこう]は 探偵[たんてい]です。
sentences.english: The main character of that movie is a detective.
sentences.question: あの映画の主人公は何ですか？
sentences.question_english: What is the main character of that movie?

sentences.japanese: 警察[けいさつ]は 内偵[ないてい]で 情報[じょうほう]を 集[あつ]めました。
sentences.english: The police gathered information through a secret investigation.
sentences.question: 警察はどうやって情報を集めましたか？
sentences.question_english: How did the police gather information?

sentences.japanese: 子供[こども]は 暗[くら]い 部屋[へや]を 恐[おそ]れています。
sentences.english: The child is afraid of dark rooms.
sentences.question: 子供は何を恐れていますか？
sentences.question_english: What is the child afraid of?

sentences.japanese: まちがった 地図[ちず]は 人[ひと]を 迷[まよ]わします。
sentences.english: A wrong map misleads people.
sentences.question: まちがった地図はどうしますか？
sentences.question_english: What does a wrong map do?

sentences.japanese: テーブルの 上[うえ]に 本[ほん]を 積[つ]みました。
sentences.english: I piled books on top of the table.
sentences.question: どこに本を積みましたか？
sentences.question_english: Where did you pile the books?

sentences.japanese: トラックに 荷物[にもつ]を 積[つ]んでいます。
sentences.english: They are loading luggage onto the truck.
sentences.question: 何に荷物を積んでいますか？
sentences.question_english: What are they loading the luggage onto?

sentences.japanese: 学校[がっこう]がパーティーを 主催[しゅさい]します。
sentences.english: The school is hosting a party.
sentences.question: だれがパーティーを主催しますか？
sentences.question_english: Who is hosting the party?

sentences.japanese: 先生[せんせい]は 宿題[しゅくだい]を 出[だ]すように 催促[さいそく]しました。
sentences.english: The teacher urged the students to hand in their homework.
sentences.question: 先生は何を催促しましたか？
sentences.question_english: What did the teacher urge?

sentences.japanese: あなたは幾度[いくど]も同[おな]じ間違[まちが]いをしますね。
sentences.english: You make the same mistake over and over again.
sentences.question: どんな間違いをしますか？
sentences.question_english: What kind of mistake do they make?

sentences.japanese: 幾度[いくたび]電話[でんわ]しても、返事[へんじ]がありませんでした。
sentences.english: No matter how many times I called, there was no reply.
sentences.question: 電話をしたとき、どうでしたか？
sentences.question_english: What happened when they called?

sentences.japanese: 恐[おそ]らく、明日[あした]は雨[あめ]が降[ふ]るでしょう。
sentences.english: It will probably rain tomorrow.
sentences.question: 明日の天気はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What will the weather be like tomorrow?

sentences.japanese: 彼[かれ]は恐[おそ]らく今日[きょう]来[こ]ないと思[おも]います。
sentences.english: I think he probably won't come today.
sentences.question: 彼は今日来ますか？
sentences.question_english: Will he come today?

sentences.japanese: 子[こ]どもは暗[くら]い部屋[へや]に恐[おそ]れを感[かん]じました。
sentences.english: The child felt fear in the dark room.
sentences.question: 子どもはどこで恐れを感じましたか？
sentences.question_english: Where did the child feel fear?

sentences.japanese: 高[たか]いところへの恐[おそ]れがあるので、飛行機[ひこうき]が苦手[にがて]です。
sentences.english: I am not good with airplanes because I have a fear of heights.
sentences.question: なぜ飛行機が苦手ですか？
sentences.question_english: Why are they not good with airplanes?

sentences.japanese: その有名[ゆうめい]な歌手[かしゅ]には用心棒[ようじんぼう]がいます。
sentences.english: That famous singer has a bodyguard.
sentences.question: 用心棒がいるのは誰ですか？
sentences.question_english: Who has a bodyguard?

sentences.japanese: 用心棒[ようじんぼう]はドアの前[まえ]に立[た]っていました。
sentences.english: The bodyguard was standing in front of the door.
sentences.question: 用心棒はどこにいましたか？
sentences.question_english: Where was the bodyguard?

sentences.japanese: 母[はは]は華道[かどう]を習[なら]っています。
sentences.english: My mother is learning flower arrangement.
sentences.question: お母さんは何を習っていますか？
sentences.question_english: What is the mother learning?

sentences.japanese: 華道[かどう]の教室[きょうしつ]は週[しゅう]に一度[いちど]あります。
sentences.english: The flower arrangement class is held once a week.
sentences.question: 華道の教室は何回ありますか？
sentences.question_english: How often is the flower arrangement class held?

sentences.japanese: そのドレスは少[すこ]し華美[かび]すぎると思[おも]います。
sentences.english: I think that dress is a little too gaudy.
sentences.question: ドレスはどんな感じですか？
sentences.question_english: What is the dress like?

sentences.japanese: パーティーの飾[かざ]りつけが華美[かび]でとてもきれいでした。
sentences.english: The party decorations were splendid and very beautiful.
sentences.question: パーティーの飾りつけはどうでしたか？
sentences.question_english: What were the party decorations like?

sentences.japanese: 電車[でんしゃ]が遅[おく]れたので、会議[かいぎ]が延[の]びました。
sentences.english: Because the train was late, the meeting was delayed.
sentences.question: なぜ会議が延びましたか？
sentences.question_english: Why was the meeting delayed?

sentences.japanese: 工事[こうじ]が延[の]びて、道路[どうろ]がまだ使[つか]えません。
sentences.english: The construction has been prolonged, and the road still cannot be used.
sentences.question: 道路は今使えますか？
sentences.question_english: Can the road be used now?

sentences.japanese: 我[わ]が国[くに]では、春[はる]に桜[さくら]が咲[さ]きます。
sentences.english: In our country, cherry blossoms bloom in spring.
sentences.question: いつ桜が咲きますか？
sentences.question_english: When do cherry blossoms bloom?

sentences.japanese: 我[わ]が国[くに]の食[た]べ物[もの]はとてもおいしいです。
sentences.english: The food in our country is very delicious.
sentences.question: 我が国の食べ物はどうですか？
sentences.question_english: What is the food in our country like?

sentences.japanese: この犬[いぬ]は雄[おす]ですか、雌[めす]ですか？
sentences.english: Is this dog male or female?
sentences.question: 何について聞いていますか？
sentences.question_english: What are they asking about?

sentences.japanese: その動物園[どうぶつえん]には雄[おす]のライオンが二頭[にとう]います。
sentences.english: That zoo has two male lions.
sentences.question: 動物園に雄のライオンは何頭いますか？
sentences.question_english: How many male lions are at the zoo?

sentences.japanese: この地域[ちいき]は新鮮[しんせん]な野菜[やさい]が豊富[ほうふ]です。
sentences.english: This area is rich in fresh vegetables.
sentences.question: この地域には何が豊富ですか？
sentences.question_english: What is abundant in this area?

sentences.japanese: 彼女[かのじょ]は経験[けいけん]が豊富[ほうふ]な先生[せんせい]です。
sentences.english: She is a teacher with abundant experience.
sentences.question: 彼女はどんな先生ですか？
sentences.question_english: What kind of teacher is she?

sentences.japanese: 新[あたら]しいかばんを買[か]うために、お金[かね]を貯[た]めています。
sentences.english: I am saving up money to buy a new bag.
sentences.question: なぜお金を貯めていますか？
sentences.question_english: Why are they saving money?

sentences.japanese: 毎月[まいつき]少[すこ]しずつお金[かね]を貯[た]めるのはいいことです。
sentences.english: It is a good thing to save a little money every month.
sentences.question: どのようにお金を貯めますか？
sentences.question_english: How do they save money?
